claim_assessments.reason: For a Noetherian local domain R of depth at least two, an injection R^r into finite torsion-free M with finite-length cokernel identifies M inside Frac(R)^r. A regular sequence f,g and annihilating power m^N imply f^N h,g^N h in R for each coordinate h. Injectivity of g^N modulo f^N and cancellation give h in R, proving surjectivity. All stated hypotheses are used.

The actual fields descend through pi_*O_Y=O_X as analytic derivations. Their map R^2 -> T_(X,x) is injective with finite-length cokernel; normal two-dimensional analytic R has depth two, so the finite-colength lemma gives the full module, not just a generic frame. Adjunction gives K_Y.C=50, contradicting the nonpositive intersection of a holomorphic pulled-back volume if x were smooth.

external_assumptions.statement: A compact nowhere-discrete analytic subset of a smooth complex surface is exceptional if and only if the intersection matrix of its irreducible components is negative definite. Exceptionality supplies a proper holomorphic contraction to a discrete set, a biholomorphism of complements and descent of holomorphic functions; the holomorphic reduction has connected fibers and normal target when its source is normal.

external_assumptions.statement: The nilradical of a complex space has a single nilpotence exponent on any relatively compact subset. Analytic structure sheaves are coherent, and coherent analytic sheaves are closed under kernels, cokernels, images, tensor products and Hom, including on nonreduced complex spaces.

external_assumptions.statement: For a proper holomorphic map of complex spaces and a coherent analytic sheaf on the source, all higher direct images are coherent. No flatness hypothesis is imposed.

external_assumptions.statement: For a proper holomorphic map pi:Y->X, a coherent source sheaf E, x in X and J=m_x O_Y, the m_x-adic completed stalk of R^q pi_*E is naturally isomorphic to the inverse limit of (R^q pi_*(E/J^rE))_x for ordinary powers r>=1. This is an inverse-limit statement, not termwise base change, and does not require flatness.
